title: Add encrypted remote backups

context.summary: Add encrypted backup archives and S3-compatible remote backup target support.
context.background: Self-host users need off-host backups that protect config, database dumps and object metadata/files.

in: Add encrypted archive generation for config, database and object backup components.
Add S3-compatible remote backup upload and download commands.
Add installer prompts for remote backup endpoint and encryption key handling.
Add restore verification from encrypted remote archives.
Remove TASK-105-owned public-readiness debt from the gate.

acceptance_criteria: Backup archives can be encrypted before leaving MINDORY_HOME.
Remote S3-compatible backup upload validates bucket access and object integrity.
Restore can decrypt and verify remote backup archives.
Secrets are never written to repository files or logs.

manual_checks: Confirm remote backup credentials are redacted in summaries.

risks: Encryption key loss makes backups unrecoverable and must be made explicit.
definition_of_done: Task status is changed to done.
Branch is committed and merged back into master.
